reason: I've never heard of REPAIHUB and this is a lot of money to hand to a new startup. My parents already help me with the bank paperwork in India, so I would rather pay a bit of hassle than a $199 fee to people I don't know.
objection: I've never heard of them. Why would I trust a new startup with ₹20 lakh? Fee is nothing up front, fine, but the exchange rate is the partner bank's rate and I can't see the real margin until I compare it to Wise and my bank.
would_change_my_mind: A name I recognise vouching for them, or reviews from other NRO customers who moved lakhs of rupees. A sample receipt showing the actual rate against mid-market, and a fee under about CAD $100 for 10 lakh.
